"""Private, opt-in observer launcher for one Databricks Apps shutdown trial."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import builtins
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import math
import os
import re
import sys
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
from typing import Any

# Keep runtime-generated bytecode out of the deployed source snapshot. Apps
# otherwise writes __pycache__ files beside the candidate source on startup.
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True

from observer_metadata import _WORKER_MARKER, _safe_report
from tether_h2c_probe import probe_h2c

_REPORT_PREFIX = "TETHER_SHUTDOWN_REPORT "
_H2C_MARKER = "TETHER_DIAGNOSTIC_H2C status=passed"


class _ObservedASGI:
    def __init__(self, app: Any, nonce: str, process_uuid: str, nonce_sha256: str, protected_path: str) -> None:
        self._app = app
        self._nonce = nonce.encode("ascii")
        self._process_uuid = process_uuid.encode("ascii")
        self._nonce_sha256 = nonce_sha256.encode("ascii")
        self._protected_path = protected_path
        self._probe_version: str | None = None
        self.ingress: dict[str, object] = {
            "scope": "public-apps-ingress",
            "observed": False,
            "process_uuid": process_uuid,
            "nonce_sha256": nonce_sha256,
        }

    def observed_version(self, nonce: str) -> str | None:
        return self._probe_version if nonce.encode("ascii") == self._nonce else None

    async def __call__(self, scope: dict[str, Any], receive: Any, send: Any) -> None:
        is_protected_probe = False
        if scope.get("type") == "http":
            values = [value for key, value in scope.get("headers", ()) if key.lower() == b"x-tether-qualification-h2c-probe"]
            if values == [self._nonce]:
                version = scope.get("http_version")
                if isinstance(version, str) and version in {"1.0", "1.1", "2", "3"}:
                    if scope.get("path") == "/":
                        self._probe_version = version
                    if scope.get("path") == self._protected_path:
                        is_protected_probe = True
                        self.ingress.update({"observed": True, "asgi_http_version": version})

        async def observed_send(message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
            if is_protected_probe and message.get("type") == "http.response.start":
                status = message.get("status")
                if type(status) is int and 100 <= status <= 599:
                    self.ingress["response_status"] = status
                headers = list(message.get("headers", ()))
                headers.extend(
                    (
                        (b"x-tether-diagnostic-process", self._process_uuid),
                        (b"x-tether-diagnostic-nonce-sha256", self._nonce_sha256),
                        (b"x-tether-diagnostic-asgi-http-version", str(self.ingress.get("asgi_http_version", "")).encode("ascii")),
                        (b"cache-control", b"no-store"),
                    )
                )
                message = {**message, "headers": headers}
            await send(message)

        await self._app(scope, receive, observed_send)

    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
        return getattr(self._app, name)


class _OutputObserver:
    """Retain only the app's fixed metadata markers after the original print."""

    def __init__(self, original: Callable[..., None]) -> None:
        self.original = original
        self.report: dict[str, object] | None = None
        self.report_print_returned = False
        self.worker_invocation_id: str | None = None
        self.worker_frozen = False

    def __call__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        self.original(*args, **kwargs)
        if not args or not isinstance(args[0], str):
            return
        text = args[0]
        if text.startswith(_WORKER_MARKER) and not self.worker_frozen:
            candidate_id = text[len(_WORKER_MARKER):]
            if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}", candidate_id):
                self.worker_invocation_id = candidate_id
            return
        if self.report is not None or not text.startswith(_REPORT_PREFIX):
            return
        candidate = _safe_report(text[len(_REPORT_PREFIX):])
        if candidate is not None:
            self.report = candidate
            self.report_print_returned = True

    def freeze_worker(self) -> None:
        self.worker_frozen = True


class _SignalClock:
    """Read the launcher's own receipt clock only after its handler runs."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.received_at: float | None = None
        self.loop: Any | None = None

    def receive(self, owner: Any, name: str, original: Callable[[Any, str], None]) -> None:
        original(owner, name)
        if self.received_at is None:
            received_at = owner.received_at
            if isinstance(received_at, (int, float)) and math.isfinite(received_at):
                self.received_at = float(received_at)
                self.loop = owner._loop

    def elapsed(self) -> float | None:
        if self.received_at is None or self.loop is None:
            return None
        return max(0.0, self.loop.time() - self.received_at)


def _sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _overlay_inventory_sha256(bundle_root: Path) -> str:
    inventory_path = bundle_root / "observer_payload_inventory.json"
    if inventory_path.is_symlink():
        raise RuntimeError("observer_inventory_symlink_refused")
    raw = inventory_path.read_bytes()
    if len(raw) > 256_000:
        raise RuntimeError("observer_inventory_too_large")
    value = json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"schema_version", "files"} or value["schema_version"] != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("observer_inventory_shape_invalid")
    files = value["files"]
    if not isinstance(files, list) or not 1 <= len(files) <= 4096 or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in files):
        raise RuntimeError("observer_inventory_files_invalid")
    if files != sorted(set(files)) or "observer_payload_inventory.json" not in files:
        raise RuntimeError("observer_inventory_paths_invalid")
    required = {
        "app.yaml", "uv.lock", "observer_payload_inventory.json",
        "src/app.py", "src/observer_launcher.py", "src/observer_metadata.py",
        "src/read_observer.py", "src/tether_h2c_probe.py",
    }
    if not required.issubset(files):
        raise RuntimeError("observer_inventory_required_file_missing")
    hashes: dict[str, str] = {}
    total_bytes = 0
    for relative in files:
        pure = PurePosixPath(relative)
        if pure.is_absolute() or pure.as_posix() != relative or any(part in {"", ".", ".."} for part in pure.parts):
            raise RuntimeError("observer_inventory_path_invalid")
        path = bundle_root.joinpath(*pure.parts)
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("observer_inventory_member_unavailable")
        total_bytes += path.stat().st_size
        if total_bytes > 512 * 1024 * 1024:
            raise RuntimeError("observer_inventory_payload_too_large")
        hashes[relative] = _sha256(path)
    canonical = json.dumps(hashes, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()


def _observer_conninfo() -> str:
    from databricks.sdk import WorkspaceClient
    from psycopg.conninfo import make_conninfo

    endpoint = os.environ["TETHER_PG_ENDPOINT"]
    client = WorkspaceClient(auth_type="oauth-m2m")
    credential = client.postgres.generate_database_credential(endpoint=endpoint)
    password = credential.token
    if not isinstance(password, str) or not password:
        raise RuntimeError("observer_credential_empty")
    conninfo = make_conninfo(
        host=os.environ["TETHER_PG_HOST"],
        port=int(os.environ.get("TETHER_PG_PORT", "5432")),
        dbname=os.environ["TETHER_PG_DATABASE"],
        user=os.environ["TETHER_PG_INFRA_ROLE"],
        password=password,
        sslmode="verify-full",
        sslrootcert=os.environ["TETHER_PG_SSLROOTCERT"],
        connect_timeout=5,
        options="-c statement_timeout=3000",
    )
    return conninfo


async def _open_observer_connection() -> Any:
    from psycopg import AsyncConnection

    conninfo = await asyncio.to_thread(_observer_conninfo)
    async with asyncio.timeout(5):
        return await AsyncConnection.connect(conninfo, autocommit=True)


async def _insert_once(connection: Any, schema: str, row: dict[str, object], timeout: float) -> None:
    from psycopg import sql

    statement = sql.SQL(
        "INSERT INTO {}.{} (invocation_id, process_uuid, base_candidate_sha256, app_source_sha256, "
        "databricks_wheel_sha256, loaded_composition_sha256, observer_sha256, probe_sha256, "
        "report, report_print_returned, main_returned, signal_to_main_return_seconds, "
        "transport, h2c_completed_before_signal, overlay_snapshot_sha256) "
        "VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s::jsonb, %s, %s, %s, %s::jsonb, %s, %s)"
    ).format(sql.Identifier(schema), sql.Identifier("shutdown_observer"))
    async with asyncio.timeout(timeout):
        async with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            await cursor.execute(
                statement,
                (
                    row["invocation_id"],
                    row["process_uuid"],
                    row["base_candidate_sha256"],
                    row["app_source_sha256"],
                    row["databricks_wheel_sha256"],
                    row["loaded_composition_sha256"],
                    row["observer_sha256"],
                    row["probe_sha256"],
                    json.dumps(row["report"], separators=(",", ":")),
                    row["report_print_returned"],
                    row["main_returned"],
                    row["signal_to_main_return_seconds"],
                    json.dumps(row["transport"], separators=(",", ":")),
                    row["h2c_completed_before_signal"],
                    row["overlay_snapshot_sha256"],
                ),
            )


async def _persist_observation(
    output: _OutputObserver,
    signal_clock: _SignalClock,
    connection: Any,
    *,
    main_returned: bool,
    schema: str,
    process_uuid: str,
    nonce_sha256: str,
    base_candidate_sha256: str,
    app_source_sha256: str,
    databricks_wheel_sha256: str,
    loaded_composition_sha256: str,
    overlay_snapshot_sha256: str,
    observer_sha256: str,
    probe_sha256: str,
    observed_app: _ObservedASGI | None,
    h2c_result: dict[str, object],
    h2c_completed_at: float | None,
    insert: Callable[..., Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    """Persist once, only after the wrapped app main path has returned."""
    invocation_id = output.worker_invocation_id
    report = output.report
    if not output.report_print_returned or report is None or invocation_id is None:
        return None
    elapsed_seconds = signal_clock.elapsed()
    budget = report["configured_shutdown_seconds"]
    if not isinstance(elapsed_seconds, (int, float)) or not isinstance(budget, (int, float)):
        raise RuntimeError("observer_shutdown_clock_unavailable")
    remaining = budget - elapsed_seconds
    if remaining <= 0:
        raise TimeoutError("observer_budget_exhausted")
    transport = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "invocation_id": invocation_id,
        "process_uuid": process_uuid,
        "nonce_sha256": nonce_sha256,
        "loaded_module_sha256": {
            "carrier_composition": loaded_composition_sha256,
            "launcher": app_source_sha256,
        },
        "ingress": {} if observed_app is None else observed_app.ingress,
        "h2c": h2c_result,
    }
    row: dict[str, object] = {
        "invocation_id": invocation_id,
        "process_uuid": process_uuid,
        "base_candidate_sha256": base_candidate_sha256,
        "app_source_sha256": app_source_sha256,
        "databricks_wheel_sha256": databricks_wheel_sha256,
        "loaded_composition_sha256": loaded_composition_sha256,
        "overlay_snapshot_sha256": overlay_snapshot_sha256,
        "observer_sha256": observer_sha256,
        "probe_sha256": probe_sha256,
        "report": report,
        "report_print_returned": output.report_print_returned,
        "main_returned": main_returned,
        "signal_to_main_return_seconds": elapsed_seconds,
        "h2c_completed_before_signal": (
            h2c_completed_at is not None
            and signal_clock.received_at is not None
            and h2c_completed_at <= signal_clock.received_at
        ),
        "transport": transport,
    }
    sink = _insert_once if insert is None else insert
    await sink(connection, schema, row, min(remaining, 3.0))
    return row


async def main() -> None:
    required = ("TETHER_DIAG_BASE_CANDIDATE_SHA256", "TETHER_DIAG_SCHEMA", "DATABRICKS_APP_PORT", "TETHER_DIAG_PROBE_NONCE")
    values = {name: os.environ[name] for name in required}
    if len(values["TETHER_DIAG_BASE_CANDIDATE_SHA256"]) != 64 or any(ch not in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in values["TETHER_DIAG_BASE_CANDIDATE_SHA256"]):
        raise RuntimeError("observer_bundle_digest_invalid")
    if not values["TETHER_DIAG_SCHEMA"].replace("_", "").isalnum():
        raise RuntimeError("observer_schema_invalid")
    nonce = values["TETHER_DIAG_PROBE_NONCE"]
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", nonce):
        raise RuntimeError("observer_probe_nonce_invalid")
    protected_path = os.environ.get("TETHER_DIAG_PROTECTED_PATH", "/api/v1/capabilities")
    if not protected_path.startswith("/") or "?" in protected_path or "#" in protected_path:
        raise RuntimeError("observer_protected_path_invalid")
    process_uuid = str(uuid.uuid4())
    process_uuid = process_uuid.replace("-", "")
    nonce_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(nonce.encode("ascii")).hexdigest()
    source_path = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "app.py"
    module = importlib.import_module("app")
    overlay_snapshot_sha256 = _overlay_inventory_sha256(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1])
    source_hash = _sha256(source_path)
    observer_hash = _sha256(Path(__file__))
    probe_hash = _sha256(Path(__file__).with_name("tether_h2c_probe.py"))
    wheel_files = list((Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "wheelhouse").glob("novirhiza_tether_databricks-*.whl"))
    if len(wheel_files) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("observer_databricks_wheel_ambiguous")
    wheel_hash = _sha256(wheel_files[0])
    composition = importlib.import_module("tether_databricks.composition")
    loaded_composition_hash = _sha256(Path(composition.__file__))
    observed_app: _ObservedASGI | None = None
    h2c_result: dict[str, object] = {"status": "not_started"}
    h2c_completed_at: float | None = None
    main_returned = False
    original_print: Callable[..., None] = builtins.print
    output = _OutputObserver(original_print)
    signal_clock = _SignalClock()
    original_build = module.build_reference_app
    original_serve = module.serve
    original_receive = module._ShutdownSignal._receive
    connection = await _open_observer_connection()

    def tracked_receive(owner: Any, name: str) -> None:
        signal_clock.receive(owner, name, original_receive)
        output.freeze_worker()

    async def observed_build(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> _ObservedASGI:
        nonlocal observed_app
        app = await original_build(*args, **kwargs)
        observed_app = _ObservedASGI(app, nonce, process_uuid, nonce_sha256, protected_path)
        return observed_app

    async def observed_serve(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        nonlocal h2c_result, h2c_completed_at

        def read_version(value: str) -> str | None:
            if value != nonce:
                return None
            return None if observed_app is None else observed_app.observed_version(nonce)

        async def run_probe() -> dict[str, object]:
            nonlocal h2c_result, h2c_completed_at
            try:
                result = await probe_h2c(int(values["DATABRICKS_APP_PORT"]), "/", nonce, read_version)
            except TimeoutError:
                h2c_result = {"status": "timeout"}
            except RuntimeError as error:
                allowed = {
                    "h2c_probe_connection_closed", "h2c_probe_stream_refused",
                    "h2c_probe_response_exceeds_bound", "h2c_probe_protocol_or_status_mismatch",
                }
                h2c_result = {"status": error.args[0] if error.args and error.args[0] in allowed else "other"}
            except Exception:
                h2c_result = {"status": "other"}
            else:
                # Capture the successful probe completion before scheduling its
                # callback or returning control to the server lifecycle.
                h2c_completed_at = asyncio.get_running_loop().time()
                h2c_result = {
                    **result,
                    "process_uuid": process_uuid,
                    "nonce_sha256": nonce_sha256,
                }
                original_print(_H2C_MARKER, flush=True)
            return h2c_result

        probe_task = asyncio.create_task(run_probe(), name="private-h2c-capability-probe")
        try:
            await original_serve(*args, **kwargs)
        finally:
            if not probe_task.done():
                probe_task.cancel()
            try:
                await probe_task
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                h2c_result = {"status": "cancelled_before_result"}
            h2c_result.setdefault("process_uuid", process_uuid)
            h2c_result.setdefault("nonce_sha256", nonce_sha256)

    module.build_reference_app = observed_build
    module.serve = observed_serve
    module._ShutdownSignal._receive = tracked_receive
    builtins.print = output
    try:
        await module.main()
        main_returned = True
    finally:
        builtins.print = original_print
        module.build_reference_app = original_build
        module.serve = original_serve
        module._ShutdownSignal._receive = original_receive
        try:
            await _persist_observation(
                output,
                signal_clock,
                connection,
                main_returned=main_returned,
                schema=values["TETHER_DIAG_SCHEMA"],
                process_uuid=process_uuid,
                nonce_sha256=nonce_sha256,
                base_candidate_sha256=values["TETHER_DIAG_BASE_CANDIDATE_SHA256"],
                app_source_sha256=source_hash,
                databricks_wheel_sha256=wheel_hash,
                loaded_composition_sha256=loaded_composition_hash,
                overlay_snapshot_sha256=overlay_snapshot_sha256,
                observer_sha256=observer_hash,
                probe_sha256=probe_hash,
                observed_app=observed_app,
                h2c_result=h2c_result,
                h2c_completed_at=h2c_completed_at,
            )
        finally:
            try:
                await connection.close()
            except Exception:
                original_print("TETHER_OBSERVER_CONNECTION_CLOSE status=failed", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        asyncio.run(main())
    except BaseException as error:
        category = "timeout" if isinstance(error, TimeoutError) else "io" if isinstance(error, OSError) else "other"
        builtins.print(f"TETHER_OBSERVER status=failed category={category}", flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1) from None
